name: Bevis v. City of Naperville
summary: The Seventh Circuit upheld bans on assault-style weapons and high-capacity magazines enacted by Illinois municipalities, concluding that such weapons are not protected by the Second Amendment because they are akin to military arms outside the historical scope of civilian firearm rights.
significance: This Seventh Circuit decision, which upheld assault weapons bans in Illinois municipalities and was the precursor to the ruling in this case, is central to the legal framework being challenged by petitioners.
